A week from now, on April 28th at 2 AM (PST), our service will go offline for a brief maintenance to upgrade our databases.

Vehicle polling will be momentarily disrupted, and we expect the downtime to conclude in under fifteen minutes.

Thank you for your understanding.

Charge your @Tesla vehicle today (on April 22nd) to earn an Earth Day badge within the Tesla mobile app!

Note: It's not yet clear whether this implies charging at home, any fast charger, or Supercharging only.


Whole Mars Catalog (@wholemars)

Charge your Tesla on Earth day to get this special badge





— https://nitter.net/wholemars/status/2046797273200509217#m
We can confirm (based on replies) that any form of charging counts, so even a moment plugged in at home should be enough!

Historical Service Alerts are now live for @Tesla vehicles subscribed to our Pro membership! ⚙️🛠️

Teslascope can now record alerts and will soon privately analyze the alerts your vehicle receives to provide you with insights into your vehicle's health.

An update in May will expand upon this, allowing easy export of service alerts to PDF/CSV and providing access to this data via our Developer APIs.

In addition, you'll be able to enable email notifications for specific categories (such as HV alerts), perfect for managing fleets.

A new build of the @Tesla Spring update is now rolling out via 2026.14.2.

It is only going out to vehicles currently on 2026.14.1; thus, no new Full Self-Driving build has been detected at this time.
